summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Russell Investments U.S. Small Cap Equity ETF (RUSC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in small-cap stocks. The fund is actively managed, seeking long-term capital growth through investments in US small-cap companies. Security selection is based on a multi-style and multi-manager approach RUSC was launched on May 14, 2025 and is issued by Russell Investments.

holdings.infoBox: RUSC is an equity ETF with a total of 500 individual holdings. The top holdings are Ligand Pharmaceuticals stock at 0.64%, Crane NXT, Co. at 0.57%, CareDx at 0.55%, Select Water Solutions at 0.53%, and Twist Bioscience at 0.49%.
